literal: To those who are loved by those who love them, is indeed fitting the pride of saying 'we shall live'.
translation: Only to those who are loved in return by those they love does the proud confidence of saying 'we shall live' belong.
modern: தம்மை விரும்புபவர்களால் தாமும் விரும்பப்படும் பேறு பெற்றவர்களுக்கே, 'நாம் இன்பமாக வாழ்வோம்' என்னும் பெருமிதம் பொருந்தும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the necessity of mutual affection in love. The speaker observes that the proud confidence of declaring 'we shall live happily' (வாழுநம் என்னும் செருக்கு) belongs only to those who are loved back by their partners (வீழப் படுவார்க்கு). The word 'செருக்கு' here represents the joyful security and self-assurance born of reciprocal love. Without this mutual bond, the separation becomes unbearable, and the hope of life fades away.
